description.summary: private Tegra L4T GPU client buffer transport (v2)

protocol.description:
THIS IS A PRIVATE GAMESCOPE PROTOCOL. Regular Wayland clients must NOT use it.
Per-slot IMMUTABLE registration of a cross-process NVIDIA OPAQUE_FD Vulkan *buffer* (NOT DMA_BUF_EXT, NOT linux-dmabuf) plus the exact allocation and synchronisation payloads:
memoryFD, ready binary-semaphoreFD (producer signals), returned binary-semaphoreFD (consumer signals), VkBufferCreateInfo size/usage/ sharing, VkMemoryAllocateInfo allocationSize + original memoryTypeIndex, dedicated-allocation status, and deviceUUID/driverUUID.
The created object is a real wl_buffer: the client attaches it to a real wl_surface and commits. The compositor imports the *matching* OPAQUE_FD payloads on its own VkDevice/queue. The CPU only handles metadata and fds.
Registration alone must never mark a slot pending or wait on an uncommitted buffer. Import may be refused if the metadata does not exactly match a supported configuration (fail closed).

description.summary: register a slot and return its wl_buffer

arg.name: dedicated
arg.summary: 1 if a dedicated allocation was used

arg.name: ready_fd
arg.summary: OPAQUE_FD exported binary semaphore: producer signals

arg.name: returned_fd
arg.summary: OPAQUE_FD exported binary semaphore: consumer signals
